steps.say: **Updated** and a time — that is when the figures below were last fetched, so you always know whether you are reading this morning or this minute.

Pull the page down or reload it and the numbers are fetched again; the stamp moves with them. Nothing is shown until a load has genuinely succeeded, so an empty stamp means the numbers have not arrived rather than that they are old.
steps.terminal: That's the freshness of everything under it, in one line. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
